name: To Temper Thyself and Journey Far
desc:
To Temper Thyself and Journey Far is a permanent, periodic event that spans 12 weeks per phase. It is unlocked at Adventure Rank 14.

The path to the summit is paved with sweat and perseverance. Endure the toil of each day, and bountiful rewards shall follow.

value.text: To Temper Thyself and Journey Far

"Knights of Favonius" Archon Quest
"Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild" World Quest

customize.text:
Travelers can select a desired character's Stella Fortuna from the Characters in the Event Page's roster. Upon completing a phase of the event, those chosen Stella Fortuna can be claimed.
<color=#ffffff>Requirements:</color>
The player must have obtained the character
Selected Character's Stella Fortuna has not been claimed during a previous iteration of the event.
A player selects a Character at Max Constellation Level

customize.name: Masterless Stella Fortuna
customize.desc:
A precious material required for raising Ascension Limits.
A Masterless Stella Fortuna, adrift apart from the flow of fate. It awaits a voice to weave it once more into the song of the world.

customize.text:
A player hasn't manually selected a Character
The Character with the highest level will be chosen
A player hasn't manually selected a Character and there are multiple eligible recipients
The Character appearing earlier in the roster will be chosen
A player has no eligible recipients
No Stella Fortuna Reward will be issued

customize.name: Baizhu
customize.desc: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

customize.name: Dehya
customize.desc: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

customize.name: Wanderer
customize.desc: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

customize.name: Nilou
customize.desc: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

customize.name: Cyno
customize.desc: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

customize.name: Tighnari
customize.desc: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart - and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

customize.name: Kamisato Ayato
customize.desc: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

customize.name: Yae Miko
customize.desc: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

customize.name: Shenhe
customize.desc: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

customize.name: Arataki Itto
customize.desc: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

customize.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
customize.desc: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

customize.name: Yoimiya
customize.desc: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

customize.name: Kamisato Ayaka
customize.desc: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

customize.name: Eula
customize.desc: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

customize.name: Hu Tao
customize.desc: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

customize.name: Xiao
customize.desc: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

customize.name: Ganyu
customize.desc: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

customize.name: Albedo
customize.desc: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

customize.name: Tartaglia
customize.desc: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

customize.name: Klee
customize.desc: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

customize.name: Keqing
customize.desc: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

customize.name: Mona
customize.desc: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

customize.name: Qiqi
customize.desc: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

customize.name: Diluc
customize.desc: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

customize.name: Jean
customize.desc: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

customize.text: Get a Free 5-Star Stella Fortuna and Increase Your Character's Ascension Level!

<color=#ffd780>August 29, 2025</color>
"To Temper Thyself and Journey Far" & "Masterless Stella Fortuna" Explained
"To Temper Thyself and Journey Far": Rewards of Dedication

To Temper Thyself and Journey Far is a permanent, periodic event that spans 12 weeks per phase. Players must complete Adventure Encounters to reach daily training goals and weekly training goals to earn rewards.

<color=#ffffff>Requirement</color>
Reach Adventure Rank 14
"Knights of Favonius" Archon Quest
"Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild" World Quest

<color=#ffffff>Daily Training Goals</color>
Claim rewards from <color=#ffffff>4</color> Daily Commissions
Spend <color=#ffffff>120</color>

customize.name: Original Resin
customize.desc: It is said that the roots of all the Irminsul trees and blossoms in the world are intertwined at the deepest, most hidden place in the earth, and that the pattern the root system makes defines the Ley Lines of the world.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Weekly Training Goals</color>
Complete daily training goals <color=#ffffff>5</color> times

Completing the Weekly Training Goals will contribute towards Completion Progress and players can claim corresponding stage rewards. When 8 Weekly Training Goals are completed over the span of 12 weeks, players can claim the final reward.
Any completed Weekly Training Goals over 8 grant the player access to Tempered in Practice.
Unclaimed Rewards for completed objectives will be sent directly to the player's inventory.

customize.name: Mystic Enhancement Ore
customize.desc:
Weapon EXP material. Gives 10,000 EXP.
Legend has it that this refined ingot contains the memories of battles that had taken place in the land. The weapons that benefit from these memories naturally become sentient.

customize.name: Crown of Insight
customize.desc:
A precious Talent Level-Up material.
Once a medium for the storage and transfer of wisdom in ancient times. Now, wisdom is found in ancient texts and in profound speech. Nevertheless, this Crown of Insight must still be able to impart some transcendent power and wisdom to its bearer.

customize.name: Hero's Wit
customize.desc:
Character EXP material. Gives 20000 EXP.
These experiences are extremely precious for a pilgrim traveling through Teyvat in order to be closer to Celestia.

customize.name: Sanctifying Elixir
customize.desc:
A material that is consumed when defining Artifacts with the Artifact Transmuter.
Artifacts are themselves the crystallized physical manifestation of ideals and memories. This is one of the applications of the noble art of Alchemy — namely, to preserve ideals by crystallizing them inside the essence of material objects. Only in this way can they be molded according to need.

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

customize.name: Dust of Enlightenment
customize.desc:
The power of Artifacts stems from stories. Thus, sacred or profane writings may reshape them.
There is no good or evil inherent in stories. Songs and words may have the power to save as well as destroy, just as believed by the emissary who once conveyed revelations to the holiest of sovereigns, governed the nations on earth and their glory, yet eventually fell from the high heavens. To this day, whether pure or impure, these feathers can still inscribe false revelations and rewrite fated tales, yet the only outcome of defying the world is to scatter into dust.

customize.name: Sanctifying Essence
customize.desc:
Artifact EXP material. Gives 10,000 EXP.
Artifacts are themselves the physical manifestation of ideals and memories. Materials such as this, which contain the distilled essence of the power thereof, can make these memories and ideals clearer and stronger still.

customize.name: Primogem
customize.desc: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

customize.name: Transient Resin
customize.desc:
An item that can be used to replenish Original Resin. Once used, it will replenish 60 Original Resin.

Once obtained, it will automatically dissipate after a period of time.

· The expiration time will be calculated from the Monday after this item is obtained, and it will disappear seven days from then.

· Multiple Transient Resins obtained on different weeks will have their expiration dates counted independently.

Pure energy that will dissipate with time. In this, it is similar to all else that is lovely in this world. But seize this opportunity and go make the world a slightly better place, as is fitting for one who dwells within the bounds of "time."
